title: Humans and aliens working side by side at Mount Zeal

tellings.quote: And I've heard that from people who absolutely know for sure. Yeah.

plain: At Mount Zeil in Australia, the claim goes, humans and aliens work side by side. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, tells Michels he has heard this "from people who absolutely know for sure", without naming them. If true, it would mean a hidden joint site of humans and beings from elsewhere.
